For a plain case like this — where I hadn't touched anything — pointing it at the new address and having the site, title, description, and picture all refresh to MDN is sensible. That's what I'd want when I simply pasted the wrong link in the first place.

But the case you actually asked about — where I'd already renamed the title to something like "Recipes I want to try" and written my own description — isn't really shown here, because this started from a fresh save. And honestly, that's the case I care about most. If I've bothered to put my own words on a bookmark, I'd be unhappy to have them silently wiped just because I corrected the address. I'd expect the app to keep what I typed, or at least check with me before throwing my own title and description away. Losing my personalizing without warning would feel wrong.

Could you show me that specific situation — personalize the title and description first, then change the address — so I can see what happens to my own edits?
